_comment: Campaign windows are shifted forward by whole weeks at load time, relative to dates_anchored_to (demo_common.merchant_fixtures.load_campaigns), the same shift merchant_metrics.json gets. Author the dates as if dates_anchored_to were today.

campaigns.name: Weekly ad: berries, rotisserie, and pantry staples
campaigns.objective: Feature RB-1007 strawberries, RB-2203 rotisserie chicken, RB-1503 penne, and RB-1516 marinara to build a quick weeknight meal basket.
campaigns.channel: Riverbend Market circular, app home page, and shelf tags

campaigns.name: Digital coupon: Riverbend Everyday family stock-up
campaigns.objective: Lift own-brand repeat purchase with app coupons on RB-1202 milk, RB-1301 bread, RB-1505 rice, RB-1701 chips, and RB-1904 bath tissue.

campaigns.name: Fuel Stop rewards: dinner tonight bundle
campaigns.objective: Award bonus Riverbend Rewards points on RB-2201 roasted chicken, RB-2204 side salad, and RB-1602 sparkling water; points convert to cents-per-gallon fuel savings.
campaigns.channel: app offer plus fuel pump screen

campaigns.name: End cap reset: taco night
campaigns.objective: Move slow end-cap inventory by bundling RB-1310 tortillas, RB-1520 salsa, RB-1522 seasoning, RB-1013 peppers, and RB-1105 ground beef family packs.
campaigns.channel: store end cap and associate prompt at curbside staging

campaigns.name: Prepared foods markdown rescue
campaigns.objective: Test late-day markdowns on RB-2202 meals, RB-2206 peanut noodle salad, RB-2208 veggie wraps, and RB-2212 macaroni to reduce shrink before close.
campaigns.channel: digital shelf tag and associate handheld alert
